name: How long does it typically take to complete a bathroom addition project?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to complete a bathroom addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a bathroom addition varies based on the project's scope and complexity. A smaller half-bath addition might take 4-6 weeks from demolition to final touches. A larger, more complex full bathroom addition, especially if it involves extensive plumbing or structural changes, can take 8-12 weeks or longer. Factors like permitting, material lead times, and inspection schedules can also influence the overall duration. We provide a detailed project schedule after the design and material selections are finalized.
acceptedAnswer.description: A bathroom addition usually takes 4-12 weeks, depending on its size and complexity, as well as permitting and material availability.
